Tier2 link conversion with accessible names disabled

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"inline_data_media\":\"AltTextOnly\",\"tier_strategy\":\"tier2\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convertWithAccessibleNames(html: "<p>see <a href=\"https://example.com/x\">GitHub<svg aria-label=\"(opens in new tab)\"><use href=\"#ext\"></use></svg></a> now</p>", useAccessibleNames: false, options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
